title: Medical Record Number structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of MRN candidates paired with structural rejection reasons and a ``pattern_variant`` dispatch tag. Mirrors the three Swift patterns at PIIDetector.swift:707 (declared at :686-702): mrn.labeled, mrn.patientID, mrn.institution.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one MRN candidate tagged with its pattern variant and verdict.

text.description: Full candidate string as it would appear in source text.

value.description: The MRN value portion (after label, or the whole institution-shape string).

pattern_variant.description: Which of the three Swift MRN patterns this vector targets (mrn.labeled / mrn.patientID / mrn.institution).

valid.description: Whether the candidate matches its targeted Swift MRN regex.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this MRN, or null if valid.
